title: Towing spike, a long log (two tugs): hook a drifting log, tow it along the bank, tug it off the snag, land it at the slip
about: The M7 spike on the lab's south shore (debug only). A placeholder log drifts west down the water from the east edge of the view (x 19, y 30). Tap the log: the farmer walks to the bank in reach and hooks it (3-tile rope). Tap the slip (the planks where the road meets the shore, 13,28) or the water near it: he walks along the bank and the log follows. It catches on the rock at (17,29): it stops, tilts and bobs, the rope goes taut and he stops; Action or a tap on the log tugs it free and the walk resumes. At the slip it lands by itself (+3 Timber; a long log needs two tugs). Another log comes after. `__farm.dev.tow()` reads the taps and the time from the first input to the landing.
